evidence: Lighthouse Accessibility 76/100: 3 img elements have no alt attribute
user_impact: Screen reader users cannot understand what the images show
recommended_fix: Add short descriptive alt text to informative images and alt="" to decorative images

evidence: Lighthouse: input.ng-tns-c69-9.ui-inputtext has no associated label
user_impact: Screen reader users cannot tell what to enter in the field
recommended_fix: Add a label element or aria-label to every input (for example From station)

evidence: Lighthouse: button and link and menuitem elements do not have accessible names
user_impact: Users of assistive technology cannot tell what a control does
recommended_fix: Add visible text or an aria-label to each control

evidence: Lighthouse: aria-* attributes do not have valid values
user_impact: Assistive technology may announce elements incorrectly
recommended_fix: Use only valid ARIA attribute values

evidence: Lighthouse: background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio (exact ratio to be added)
user_impact: Low-vision users struggle to read the text
recommended_fix: Increase contrast to at least 4.5:1 for normal text
